lawful_semantic_statement: In historical/source scope S and empirical predicate C, observed respondent evidence supports a target response distribution/configuration with exact risk-set, support, topology, weighting state, and provenance.
forbidden_collapse: Population distribution = positioned-subject field; population prevalence = actor membership; survey answer = actor belief
D12D_dependency: NO for purely empirical fact; YES when tied to a generated subject comparator

lawful_semantic_statement: A generated-subject fact may select an empirical comparator only if an exact comparability rule maps the actor fact/value/time/scope into a survey predicate without routing through nine-stratum position binding.
forbidden_collapse: Shared label = comparator; structural position = survey coordinate; nearest category fallback
current_or_future_owner_requirement: D12D comparability seam must own exact mapping and negative/unbound states

lawful_semantic_statement: An actor-specific generated structural fact may constrain life under its own V3/CAN authority.
forbidden_collapse: Generated position = demographic survey condition; class/sect/region label automatically selects respondents
current_or_future_owner_requirement: Separate actor->empirical comparability authority if a structural fact is ever intended as a comparator; D10 remains controlling otherwise

lawful_semantic_statement: Given exact lawfully comparable generated-subject properties and historical/source scope, the field describes uncertainty-bearing empirical support over plausible joint response/disposition configurations.
forbidden_collapse: Field = actor belief; field probability = present actor belief probability; field mode = persona; field support = biography
current_or_future_owner_requirement: A separately governed downstream V3 admission/metabolism rule is required before the field can constrain actor development

lawful_semantic_statement: Configuration C has positive observed raw/weighted support in the comparator population under exact scope/risk set.
forbidden_collapse: Actor currently has C; actor will develop C; C is identity/persona
current_or_future_owner_requirement: V3 may only later admit/use this as an upstream developmental constraint under its own rule

lawful_semantic_statement: Configuration is empirically observed but support is weak/uncertain; low support is evidence of rarity/weak estimation only.
forbidden_collapse: Low support = impossible; low support = forbidden actor outcome
current_or_future_owner_requirement: Empirical support/uncertainty typing; later V3 use remains separately governed

object_or_transition: Zero-observed target configuration with positive conditioner denominator
lawful_semantic_statement: No respondents in the exact sampled risk set were observed in configuration C under this scope.
forbidden_collapse: Observed zero = metaphysical impossibility; actor cannot develop C
current_or_future_owner_requirement: Empirical producer must type observed zero separately from impossibility/negative authority

lawful_semantic_statement: No eligible observed respondent supports the exact conditioner, so the conditional field is undefined / has no empirical basis.
forbidden_collapse: Fallback to population marginal; uniform distribution; all target configurations assigned probability zero; actor forced to nearest cohort
current_or_future_owner_requirement: Empirical query layer must return typed no-basis/out-of-support; no probability normalization

lawful_semantic_statement: Question availability/routing is part of risk-set/topology semantics and may be a typed nonresponse state where authority permits.
forbidden_collapse: NOT_ASKED = substantive answer; routed-out respondents silently dropped from denominator without provenance

lawful_semantic_statement: Two lawful source-scoped possibility fields may disagree and remain separate empirical objects.
forbidden_collapse: Naive pooling = one truth; disagreement resolved by averaging; cross-source respondent join invented
current_or_future_owner_requirement: Cross-survey composition authority is separate; D12E only requires source identity and disagreement preservation

lawful_semantic_statement: A joint response field cannot be asserted across question/source universes that lack a lawful same-respondent binder or exact information-equivalent contingency.
forbidden_collapse: Multiply marginals; join on geography/source label; treat independent samples as one joint respondent universe
current_or_future_owner_requirement: Empirical query/composition authority must fail typed rather than synthesize cotravel

lawful_semantic_statement: Independent sampling is lossless only if exact mutual conditional independence under the same conditioner, risk set, measure, scope, topology, and support is positively established for every target configuration.
forbidden_collapse: Pairwise zero association = mutual independence; product of separately scoped marginals = exact joint
current_or_future_owner_requirement: Exact conditional-independence/factorization authority or exact empirical proof bound to the query

lawful_semantic_statement: Complete pairwise contingencies describe every 2-variable target but do not generally determine k-way geometry for k>2.
forbidden_collapse: Pairwise association = full joint; pairwise NMI/Cramer's V = possibility geometry
current_or_future_owner_requirement: Higher-order joint or exact information-equivalent factorization required when k>2

lawful_semantic_statement: For one bounded target, an exhaustive list of every nonzero configuration plus exact denominator, topology, scope, and explicit zero semantics is information-equivalent to the full dense contingency.
forbidden_collapse: Top-k/thresholded pattern list = exhaustive support; omitted = zero
current_or_future_owner_requirement: Exhaustiveness/provenance must be proved for the exact query

lawful_semantic_statement: A factor graph/Bayesian-network-like representation may be information-equivalent only if its exact factorization and parameterization reproduce the full conditional joint and support/typed states for the authorized query.
forbidden_collapse: Convenient model fit = exact empirical geometry; approximate factorization = lawful no-loss replacement
current_or_future_owner_requirement: Separate exact factorization authority/proof; representation choice remains D15/D13 jurisdiction

lawful_semantic_statement: Disposition/orientation/framework/response tendencies become actor state only through generated causal history and an owning V3 transition.
forbidden_collapse: Possibility-field mass copied into disposition; structural prior copied into framework
D12D_dependency: NO additional D12D after field exists, but field admission remains separately governed

lawful_semantic_statement: Belief or knowledge requires an exact actor epistemic effect/claim under V3 authority and actor-specific causal parentage.
forbidden_collapse: Possibility-field probability = actor belief probability; survey modal answer = belief; exposure/statistical plausibility = knowledge
current_or_future_owner_requirement: ADP-017 plus domain-owning V3 causal rule

lawful_semantic_statement: Actor response is a generated causal transaction from lawful actor-side parents; the empirical field may at most be an upstream constraint if separately admitted.
forbidden_collapse: Sample from field = actor response; likely population response = actor action
current_or_future_owner_requirement: V3 response authority and causal history
